title: jasminum triflorum
intro: Jasminum triflorum, commonly known as the three-flowered jasmine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Oleaceae. It is known for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Jasminum triflorum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce stress, promote relaxation, and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing anxiety and improving sleep quality.
